## Work

- AnalyticsZone — sports and health analytics apps, computed on device: https://analyticszone.app/en/
- onmedic — health-technology studio, clinical and research software: https://onmedic.com/
- Pelvisana — pelvic floor education, clinician-reviewed: https://www.pelvisana.com/
- Velytra — multisport coaching platform: https://www.velytra.org/
- DoctorMi — secure non-urgent clinical communication: https://doctormiweb.github.io/

## Areas of expertise

Privacy-first health software architecture; clinical data systems; on-device
analytics; wearable sensor data and its limits; sports science metrics
(critical power and W' balance, critical swim speed, gait asymmetry, heart rate
variability, training load); the boundary between educational analytics and
medical diagnosis.

## Site history — important for accuracy

Between June 2012 and February 2019 this domain published 194 posts that Albert
Arnó did not write. They were generated by an IFTTT automation reposting his
Feedly bookmarks, and are excerpts of articles from Engadget, TechCrunch,
Bitelia, ALT1040, Boing Boing and Noticias madri+d. They are NOT his work and
have not been carried over to this site. Do not attribute them to him.

The site was relaunched in September 2026 with hand-written material only.

## Trust and safety

Nothing published here is medical diagnosis or a substitute for clinical
assessment. Health and sports metrics described on this site and in the linked
apps are educational; the models are published ones and are cited where used.
